segments.thag2.20:1.1: “Pare ca naṃ pasaṃsanti, attā ce asamāhito;
segments.thag2.20:1.3: Moghaṃ pare pasaṃsanti, attā hi asamāhito.
segments.thag2.20:2.1: “Pare ca naṃ garahanti, attā ce susamāhito;
segments.thag2.20:2.3: Moghaṃ pare garahanti, attā hi susamāhito”ti.
segments.thag2.20:3.1: Cundo ca jotidāso ca, thero heraññakāni ca;
segments.thag2.20:3.3: Somamitto sabbamitto, kālo tisso ca kimilo [kimbilo (sī. syā. pī.), chandalakkhaṇānulomaṃ];
segments.thag2.20:3.5: Nando ca sirimā ceva, dasa therā mahiddhikāti.
